newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani floods kill 111 people in 11 days.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani floods kill 111 people in 11 days.

text.p: Floods have killed 111 people and inundated over 3,000 villages in Pakistan's central province of Punjab in the past 11 days, an official said on Tuesday.

Punjab Relief Commissioner Tariq Saeed Haroon, quoted by the official APP news agency, said 36 people had died in the provincial capital Lahore, 21 people in the Narowal district, 11 in Jhang district and nine in the Sialkot district last week.

At least eight people were killed in Kasur, eight in Sheikhupura and seven in Multan. The other deaths occurred in elsewhere in Punjab when the Ravi and Chenab rivers broke their banks and flooded thousands of villages, Haroon added.
He said floods had affected about 21 districts in Punjab, displacing about 1.3 million people in 3,299 villages, where he said government relief efforts were under way.
Officials said this week that floods had destroyed about 75,000 375-lb bales of cotton on farmland in the Punjab. Cotton dealers say at least 100,000 bales were ruined.
